description: Eight adders, each giving the sum of the two signals patched into its row

inputs.text: One of the two signals added together on that row; with nothing patched it takes the A signal of the nearest row above that has one, or 0V if there is none
One of the two signals added together on that row; with nothing patched it takes the B signal of the nearest row above that has one, or 0V if there is none

outputs.text: The sum of the two signals on that row

notes: every row works polyphonically, and an output carries as many channels as the wider of its two inputs
